description: This file contains JavaScript functions and classes related to transferring options between select boxes, including methods for selecting, unselecting, sorting, moving, copying, and updating options, as well as a class 'OptionTransfer' for managing transfer operations within a form.

classes.name: OptionTransfer
classes.description: A class to manage transferring options between two select elements within a form, including initialization, updating, and configuration methods.

methods.name: hasOptions
methods.description: Checks if the given object has options.

methods.name: selectUnselectMatchingOptions
methods.description: Selects or unselects options in a select box matching a regex.

methods.name: selectMatchingOptions
methods.description: Selects options matching a regex.

methods.name: selectOnlyMatchingOptions
methods.description: Selects only options matching a regex.

methods.name: unSelectMatchingOptions
methods.description: Unselects options matching a regex.

methods.name: sortSelect
methods.description: Sorts options in a select box alphabetically.

methods.name: selectAllOptions
methods.description: Selects all options in a select box.

methods.name: moveSelectedOptions
methods.description: Moves selected options from one select box to another.

methods.name: copySelectedOptions
methods.description: Copies selected options from one select box to another.

methods.name: moveAllOptions
methods.description: Moves all options from one select box to another.

methods.name: copyAllOptions
methods.description: Copies all options from one select box to another.

methods.name: swapOptions
methods.description: Swaps two options within a select box.

methods.name: moveOptionUp
methods.description: Moves a selected option up in the list.

methods.name: moveOptionDown
methods.description: Moves a selected option down in the list.

methods.name: removeSelectedOptions
methods.description: Removes selected options from a select box.

methods.name: removeAllOptions
methods.description: Removes all options from a select box.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a new option to a select box.

methods.name: OT_transferLeft
methods.description: Transfers selected options from right to left.

methods.name: OT_transferRight
methods.description: Transfers selected options from left to right.

methods.name: OT_transferAllLeft
methods.description: Transfers all options from right to left.

methods.name: OT_transferAllRight
methods.description: Transfers all options from left to right.

methods.name: OT_saveRemovedLeftOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for removed options on the left.

methods.name: OT_saveRemovedRightOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for removed options on the right.

methods.name: OT_saveAddedLeftOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for added options on the left.

methods.name: OT_saveAddedRightOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for added options on the right.

methods.name: OT_saveNewLeftOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for new options on the left.

methods.name: OT_saveNewRightOptions
methods.description: Saves the field for new options on the right.

methods.name: OT_update
methods.description: Updates the transfer state and related fields.

methods.name: OT_join
methods.description: Joins object values into a string with a delimiter.

methods.name: OT_setDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the delimiter for joining options.

methods.name: OT_setAutoSort
methods.description: Sets whether options should be auto-sorted.

methods.name: OT_setStaticOptionRegex
methods.description: Sets the regex for static options.

methods.name: OT_init
methods.description: Initializes the OptionTransfer object with form elements.

methods.name: OptionTransfer
methods.description: Constructor for the OptionTransfer class managing option transfers between two select elements.
